facts: Incident took place on the first upwind leg 2 minutes after the start of race, 5-6 knots, flat water
197117 (POL) and 216111 (IRL) were sailing on a close-hauled course on port, 216111 to windward and parallel to 197117
197117 saw a boat approaching on starboard and called for room to tack 2 boat lengths from starboard boat
216111 immediately tacked onto starboard and completed her tack
197117 tacked onto starboard. After passing head to wind, 197117 made contact with 216111’s starboard stern quarter 2 feet ahead of the stern
conclusions: 197117 to windward failed to keep clear of 216111 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
197117 did not avoid contact with 216111 when it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14.
